# Klasek Painting

Family-owned exterior house painting and repair contractor serving Chicago's western Cook County suburbs for 30+ years. Specializes in exterior repaints, stucco, siding (cedar, Hardie board, aluminum, vinyl), brick painting/staining/repair, historic homes, color consultation, and self-performed seamless gutter installation.

## Business details

- Name: Klasek Painting
- Address: 4415 S. Custer, Lyons, IL 60534
- Phone: (708) 267-0682
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–5:00 PM
- Established: 1992 (30+ years in business)
- Credentials: Licensed, EPA Lead-Safe Certified, PDCA member
- Paint brands used: Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Valspar, Behr
- Service note: Seamless gutters are installed in-house with the company's own on-site gutter machine — no subcontractors.
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Klasek+Painting/
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/klasek-painting-lyons
